message.content:
This is a household kitchen cutting board with stainless steel outer surfaces, an MDF core, and TPR edging. It is a composite article, and the stainless steel surfaces give it its essential character, so classification is as a stainless steel kitchenware article.

The candidates are:
- 7323.93 covers table, kitchen or other household articles of stainless steel. 7323.93.00 is split into 7323.93.0010 (cooking ware), 7323.93.0020, 7323.93.0030, 7323.93.0045 and 7323.93.0060 (other, such as kitchenware), and 7323.93.0090. I recall 7323.93.0090 as "Other", but I am not certain of the exact statistical suffixes.
- 4421.99 (other articles of wood) would apply if the wood core were the essential character. It does not fit well here.
- 3924.10 (plastic kitchenware) does not fit either.

I recall CBP rulings classifying stainless steel cutting boards with an MDF core in 7323.93.0090, and I am going with that.
